note: FRONT reaches its limit in cornering -> EKF & GP recover the peak. REAR does not (this car is understeer, the front saturates first) -> the rear peak is never sampled, so EKF EXTRAPOLATES and the GP stays conservative with a wide band -- exactly the one-pull-test limitation: you can only estimate a limit you actually approach. Set alpha_ref from the GP lower bound and RELAX it as the driven slip range grows.
